/.title: BalkanExplorer — AI Trip Planner for the Balkans
/.description: Plan a day-by-day trip through Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia and Montenegro. Pick your dates, budget and travel style and get a mapped itinerary in seconds.

/destinations.title: Balkan Destinations: Kotor, Ohrid, Sarandë, Prizren & More
/destinations.description: Browse the Balkans' best towns and coastlines — Kotor, Ohrid, Sarandë, Prizren, Gjirokastër, Budva, Pejë and Skopje — with ratings, highlights and travel tips.

/how-it-works.title: How It Works
/how-it-works.description: From picking a destination to sharing your trip: the steps to plan a Balkan itinerary with BalkanExplorer.

/travel-tips.title: Balkan Travel Tips
/travel-tips.description: Practical advice before you go: getting around by bus, cash and currencies, local SIM cards, safety, etiquette and the languages you will hear.

/community.title: Traveler Community
/community.description: Trip stories, photos and recommendations from travelers exploring Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia and Montenegro.

/help-center.title: Help Center & FAQ
/help-center.description: Answers to common questions about planning trips, saving itineraries, PDF export and your BalkanExplorer account.

/about.title: About Us
/about.description: The story behind BalkanExplorer and why we set out to make trips across Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia and Montenegro easier to plan.

/contact.title: Contact Us
/contact.description: Get in touch with the BalkanExplorer team about your trip, partnerships or feedback.

/features/itinerary-builder.title: AI Itinerary Builder
/features/itinerary-builder.description: A day-by-day Balkan itinerary built around real restaurants, museums and landmarks from OpenStreetMap, matched to your dates and travel style.

/features/route-mapping.title: Route Mapping
/features/route-mapping.description: See every stop of your Balkan itinerary on a real map, day by day, using the exact coordinates of each place.

/features/pdf-export.title: PDF Itinerary Export
/features/pdf-export.description: Download your Balkan itinerary as a clean PDF to use offline or share with your travel companions.

/features/support.title: Traveler Support
/features/support.description: Help with your trip or the app, whenever you need it: a searchable help center plus a real person to contact.
